description: This file contains unit tests for the WindowPlacement utility in a macOS application, verifying window positioning behaviors such as centering, corner placement, and ensuring on-screen visibility.

methods.name: centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Test that centeredFrame returns zero origin when given zero bounds.

methods.name: centered frame clamps to bounds and centers
methods.description: Test that centeredFrame clamps to bounds and centers the window when size exceeds bounds.

methods.name: top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin
methods.description: Test that topRightFrame returns zero origin when given zero bounds.

methods.name: top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding
methods.description: Test that topRightFrame positions the window at the top right with padding, clamped to bounds.

methods.name: ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen
methods.description: Test that ensureOnScreen moves an offscreen window to a fallback position.

methods.name: ensure on screen does not move visible window
methods.description: Test that ensureOnScreen does not alter the position of a window already within visible bounds.
